candidates.change_summary: Remove the require overflow guard so that an overflow revert can no longer prevent the balance update.
Remove the balance update so deposits no longer change userBalance.
Credit the deposit to address(0) instead of the caller so a different mapping key changes.
Credit only half of the deposited value to the caller's balance.
Change the return statement to return userBalance[u] + 1 instead of userBalance[u].
Change the return statement to return a constant 0 instead of the user's balance.
Change the mapping key from u to msg.sender so getBalance reports the caller's balance instead of the queried address's balance.
Replace the additive balance update with an assignment so prior balance is overwritten.
Delete the statement that credits the sender's balance.
Replace msg.value with a constant 1 in the balance increment.
Replace the credit with a debit of msg.value, decreasing the balance instead of increasing it.
